name: Serenitia
source: Serenia is a large Open World 'Dark' Fantasy Adult RPG Dungeon Crawler where you play as the Court Wizard of the kingdom of Serenia. When a prophecy warns of a coming dark lord, you must set out on your own to prepare for what’s coming. To protect the city and those you care about, you must grow stronger by delving into ancient labyrinths and uncovering forgotten magic. Serenia combines story-driven RPG progression and dungeon exploration, with a strong focus on NSFW encounters and character interactions. Serenia is planned to be released in 3 chapters.
translation: Serenia是一款大型开放世界“黑暗”奇幻成人RPG地下城探索游戏，你将在其中扮演Serenia王国的宫廷巫师。当预言警告黑暗领主即将来临时，你必须亲自出发，为即将发生的事情做好准备。为了保护城市和你关心的人，你必须通过深入古老的迷宫并揭开被遗忘的魔法来变得更强大。Serenia结合了故事驱动的RPG进程和地下城探索，重点关注NSFW遭遇和角色互动。《Serenia》计划分3章发布。
